verdict.rationale: Twenty's docs say developers can build apps and publish them "for the community," which hints at a distribution channel. Prebuilt connectors are documented only for Google Workspace and Microsoft 365, plus Zapier as a bridge to 5,000+ apps. Slack is shown only as a workflow use case, not an installable integration. Missing for 10: an evidenced app marketplace with one-click install, prebuilt Slack, support desk, marketing and data warehouse integrations, and any hands-on or independent confirmation.
